summary: Two setting rows, each with a label, a description and a Switch on the right.
use: Preference lists such as notification settings, one toggle per row.
spec: `<SettingItem label="Email notifications" description="Receive an email for every mention.">`
`<SettingItem label="Weekly digest" description="One summary every Monday.">`
Each row wraps `<Switch bind:checked={email} />` or `<Switch bind:checked={digest} />` as children
Initial state: `$state(true)` for email, `$state(false)` for digest
